text_block_list.text:
Eep!?
Did you... see that just now?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Huh? What's wrong?
This scene is totally hilarious.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Straw... wait... whaaat?
A ghost was dancing the samba!?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
The scary creature itself is having fun...?
You can't be serious...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Terrified by a ghost in a comedy movie,
Daring Heart was thrown off her game...
